subject: Future Tech
title: Desalination and Water Security
description: A quick win: understand Desalination and Water Security.

hook.text: 2 billion people lack clean drinking water. Desalination can fix that, but it's massively energy-intensive.

buildup.text: Removing salt from seawater requires enormous heat and electricity.

discovery.text: A fusion-powered desalination plant could produce fresh water at a fraction of today's carbon cost.

twist.text: Water scarcity drives conflict. The Middle East, North Africa, and Central Asia face wars over shrinking water supplies.

climax.text: Cheap fusion energy turns the ocean into a freshwater source. It could end water wars before they start.

punchline.text: Unlimited energy makes unlimited clean water possible.

quiz.question: How could fusion help solve water scarcity?
